search_text:
曲线 $L$ 的坐标方程是 $r=r(\theta),\ (\theta_1\leq\theta\leq\theta_2)$，则 $I=\int_Lf(x,y)ds=$（ ） $\int_{\theta_1}^{\theta_2}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)\sqrt{r^2(\theta)+r\prime(\theta)^2}d\theta$ $\int_{\theta_1}^{\theta_2}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)d\theta$ $\int_{\theta_1}^{\theta_2}f(x,y)\sqrt{1+y\prime{}^2}dx$ $\int_{\theta_1}^{\theta_2}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)\sqrt{1+r\prime(\theta)^2}d\theta$ 解答 $x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta,ds=\sqrt{r^2+r'^2}d\theta$，于是

$$
I=\int_{\theta_1}^{\theta_2}f(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)\bullet\sqrt{r^2(\theta)+r'^2(\theta)}d\theta.
$$
